references.text: Psalm 22 describes the sufferings of a righteous person, which Christians have traditionally interpreted as a prophecy of Jesus' suffering and death on the cross, reflected in the description of Golgotha in Matthew 27:33.
Isaiah 53 contains the prophecy of the suffering servant, which Christianity interprets as a prediction of Jesus' suffering and death, parallel to the events at Golgotha described in Matthew 27:33.
Mark 15:22 also mentions Golgotha as the place where Jesus was crucified, directly related to the event described in Matthew 27:33.
Luke 23:33 also refers to Golgotha as the place of Jesus' crucifixion, parallel to Matthew 27:33.
John 19:17 also identifies Golgotha as the place where Jesus was crucified, corresponding with the description in Matthew 27:33.
